title: Morning Intel
bullets: Markets: Stocks slipped from record highs Wednesday — Dow -341pts (-0.7%), S&P 500 and Nasdaq both -0.2%; 10-year Treasury yield eased to 5.276% after a well-received $39B note auction.
Markets: Brent crude fell 0.4% to $100.20 despite fresh Houthi attacks on two Saudi airports; copper is up 17% YTD and near record highs on AI/data-center and electrification demand.
Companies: Caterpillar (-6%), Deere (-4%) and CNH Industrial (-6%) slid after US agencies disclosed a probe into possible anticompetitive conduct in farm-equipment manufacturing and distribution.
Companies: Skydance shares fell ~7% in their first session after the Paramount-Warner Bros. megadeal officially closed.
Macro/Policy: Fed minutes signaled no urgency for an October rate hike, though further hikes remain possible later this year; next FOMC meeting is Oct 27-28.
Macro/Policy: Markets are pricing roughly a 25% chance of an October Fed rate hike, with a quarter-point move more fully priced in by December.
